services.name: AMI / Bradenton Beach - 2 Hour Cruise - Up to 12 Passengers
services.desc: ![Description of image](https://cdn.filestackcontent.com/1XRr3bRkSjOeRXnOgnEH) Kick back, relax, and enjoy life on island time. Whether you’re soaking up the sun on a peaceful daytime cruise or watching the sky light up at sunset, this is Florida’s Gulf Coast at its best. Warm breezes, calm waters, and easy vibes all around. Up to 6 Guests? No worries! Just book for 6 adults and note your actual number of guests at checkout. More than 6? We offer Bareboat Charters for groups up to 12 (11 passengers + you, the charterer + captain & crew). You’ll sign a short bareboat agreement, then pick your Private 2 Hour Charter • 6-12 Passengers • All ages

services.name: AMI / Bradenton Beach - Make It A Double - Up to 12 Passengers
services.desc: When two hours on the water just isn’t enough, this extended cruise gives you more time to soak up the best of Florida’s Gulf Coast. Drift past stunning coastal homes, watch for playful dolphins, grab a meal on the water, and cool off at one of our favorite local hangouts, the famous Jewfish Key Sandbar (weather permitting). Our Make It a Double charter is all about taking it slow and enjoying the day like the locals do, no rush, no crowds, just sunshine and salt air. If swimming in crystal-clear water isn’t your style, your captain can switch things up with stops at local waterfront bars, Private 4.5 Hours • 6-12 Passengers • All Ages
